destination.name: Jiangnan Water Towns
destination.tagline: Canal towns of old stone bridges and merchant houses east of Suzhou
destination.description: The Jiangnan water towns are a cluster of canal towns around Suzhou, among them Zhouzhuang, Tongli, Luzhi and Qiandeng. Zhouzhuang is China's oldest water town and is often called the Venice of China, with 14 stone bridges. Tongli holds the Retreat and Reflection Garden, the only UNESCO-listed Suzhou garden outside downtown, and Luzhi has Baosheng Temple, one of the Jiangnan region's top four Buddhist temples. Most visitors are Chinese, so the quiet hours are early morning and night.

goodToKnow.title: Skip public holidays
goodToKnow.detail: The narrow alleys and bridges become overcrowded and hard to move through on public holidays, and weekends are busy too.

goodToKnow.title: Arrive early or stay over
goodToKnow.detail: Most visitors arrive after 10:00. An early start or an overnight stay gives you the town at nightfall and in the morning.

goodToKnow.title: Reach Tongli by metro
goodToKnow.detail: Suzhou Metro Line 4 ends at Tongli Station, where the tourist desk sells a ticket bundling a shuttle bus and the major sights.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: Open all year, {months} are the mildest. Avoid public holidays, when the alleys overcrowd.
